text: About City Care Hospital. City Care Hospital is a 100-bed multi-speciality hospital in Sample Town, Kerala. The hospital address is 12 Main Road, Sample Town, Kerala. The main phone number of City Care Hospital is 0000-000000 and the email address is hello@citycare.example. OP timings of City Care Hospital. The outpatient department (OP) of City Care Hospital is open Monday to Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. The OP is closed on Sundays, except for emergency services. On public holidays only the emergency department and the pharmacy are open. Emergency services at City Care Hospital. The emergency department of City Care Hospital is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including Sundays and holidays. The emergency phone number is 0000-111111. The ambulance service of City Care Hospital is available 24 hours and can be requested on the emergency number. Appointments at City Care Hospital. You can book a doctor appointment at City Care Hospital by calling 0000-000000, by visiting the reception, or by using the Book an appointment option on the website. Please arrive 15 minutes before your appointment time and carry any old reports and your ID. To cancel or change an appointment, call the hospital at least 2 hours before the appointment time. Each department has two doctors. There is also a laboratory, an X-ray and scan centre, and a pharmacy. Consultation fees at City Care Hospital. The consultation fee for General Medicine is 300 rupees. The consultation fee for Pediatrics is 400 rupees. The consultation fee for Orthopedics is 500 rupees. The consultation fee for Gynecology is 500 rupees. The consultation fee for Cardiology is 700 rupees. One consultation fee is valid for a follow-up visit within 7 days. Laboratory and pharmacy at City Care Hospital. The laboratory of City Care Hospital is open every day from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Blood tests for fasting need an empty stomach for 8 to 10 hours. Test reports are usually ready on the same day, and some special tests take 2 to 3 days. The pharmacy of City Care Hospital is open 24 hours a day. Visiting hours at City Care Hospital. Only two visitors are allowed at a time per patient. Children below 12 years are not allowed in the wards. Insurance and payment at City Care Hospital. City Care Hospital accepts cashless treatment for many health insurance companies, and patients should carry the insurance card and ID proof. Payment can be made by cash, UPI or card at the billing counter. Parking and location of City Care Hospital. City Care Hospital has free parking for patients and visitors on the ground floor and in the basement. The hospital is near the Sample Town bus stand, about a 5 minute walk.
